name: Flamincome
rootCause: permissionless Convex stakeFor inflates Strategy NAV and lets VaultYUSDT overpay on withdrawAll. Lost: ~$345.9K USDT net attacker profit (gross Strategy loss ~$595K in aUSDT+USDT)

descriptions.text: permissionless Convex stakeFor inflates Strategy NAV and lets VaultYUSDT overpay on withdrawAll. Lost: ~$345.9K USDT net attacker profit (gross Strategy loss ~$595K in aUSDT+USDT)

Flamincome (legacy contracts of Flamingo Finance) was exploited due to unsafe asset accounting and valuation. The attacker flash-loaned ~$18M USDT, injected USDP/3CRV LP into the Strategy (treating a permissionlessly injectable Convex BaseRewardPool balance as its own assets and overvaluing it via Curve’s get_virtual_price() in a depegged pool), inflated the VaultYUSDT share price, and redeemed real Aave aUSDT liquidity for ~$345.9K profit.

Flamincome’s legacy USDT strategy (VaultYUSDT) was exploited. The attacker took an ~$18 million USDT flash loan via Morpho, staked manipulated Curve USDP LP into the Strategy to inflate the vault share price, then redeemed aUSDT for about $345,900 in profit.4.

On 2026-09-16, legacy Ethereum Flamincome vault contracts associated with Flamingo Finance were exploited through share-price manipulation. Public incident reports state that the attacker used an approximately $18 million USDT flash loan to inject value into a Convex-linked strategy accounting path, inflate VaultYUSDT valuation, and extract about $345,900 in profit. Public reporting and third-party incident analyses attribute the exploit to unsafe asset accounting in a legacy Flamincome USDT strategy.
